scope: Proposition 12.1 (Logarithmic alternatives) of the manuscript “Prefix Instructions and Incompressible Flows” (preprints/Prefix-Instructions-and-Incompressible-Flows-September-27-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8cd581420ec9967a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 44. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each of the left-word-box, right-word-box, and tagged-storage constructions, retain its fixed initial label and observation set. There is also an effective smooth force of fixed compact spatial support in L2([0, ∞) × R3) with exactly the same halting event and zero initial velocity. It and all its derivatives are bounded. The velocity’s spatial derivatives are O((1 + t)−1), and their first time derivatives are O((1 + t)−2), uniformly in space. The force itself is O((1 + t)−1) uniformly in space. The viscosity in this statement is the same fixed physical ν as before the time change.
